research_question: Within the fixed N2M-style reachability region, how pose-dependent is the frozen manipulation policy, and how much success does naive reachability initialization lose relative to the rollout-independent RoboCasa reference pose?

candidate_region.translation: 1 m-radius circle around task target intersected with 1 m x 1 m square around reference pose
candidate_region.yaw: reference yaw plus Uniform(-30 deg, +30 deg)
rejections: base footprint collision or outside floor
mobile-base penetration excluding normal floor support

evaluation.seed_contract: identical K rollout seeds for every sampled pose and the reference pose

interpretation_guardrail: The sampled maximum is descriptive only and is never used to select or reevaluate a pose.
